name: seamkit
description: Ask whether a merged change is live in production. Read-only MCP tools that answer with seamkit's verdict and exit code; the agent never sees a pass that production did not show.

production_url.title: Production address
production_url.description: The production address seamkit reads when the repository sets none, such as https://your.app. A repository can set its own with SEAMKIT_URL in .claude/settings.json; the tools read only that address.
